guide.title: Install OwneetOS
guide.lede: A USB stick of 4 GB or more and a controller are all you need.
guide.1.title: Check your PC
guide.1.text: A 64-bit processor, UEFI firmware, 4 GB of RAM and 32 GB of disk: most PCs from the last ten years. Graphics with Vulkan get the full experience.
guide.2.title: Download OwneetOS
guide.2.text: One file, the ISO. Coming with the first release.
guide.3.title: Write it to a USB stick
guide.3.text: With balenaEtcher or Ventoy, from Windows, macOS or Linux. Everything on the stick is erased.
guide.4.title: Start the PC from the stick
guide.4.text: Turn the PC on and open its boot menu (often F12, F11, F8 or Esc), then choose the USB stick. If the PC is set to “Legacy” or “CSM”, switch it to UEFI, and turn Secure Boot off, in its firmware settings.
guide.5.title: Install with the controller
guide.5.text: Choose “Use the whole disk”: everything on that disk is erased, Windows included. Installing next to Windows comes later.
guide.6.title: Play
guide.6.text: At the first start the controller pairs by itself; choose the language, the network and the time zone, and you are home.
guide.note: Some Windows games with anti-cheat (e.g. Battlefield 6, Valorant) need Secure Boot: they do not run on OwneetOS.
faq.title: Questions
faq.1.a: Yes: free to use, share and change, under the GPL.
faq.2.q: Do I need a mouse or a keyboard?
faq.2.a: No. Everything works with a controller, from installing it to playing. A mouse and a keyboard still work if you like.
faq.3.a: Xbox, PlayStation, Switch and most others, wired or wireless. The first one pairs by itself.
faq.4.a: Most of them, Windows games too. Games whose anti-cheat needs Secure Boot do not.
faq.5.a: Not yet: OwneetOS uses the whole disk. Installing next to Windows comes later.
faq.6.q: Can I watch films and listen to music?
faq.6.a: Yes: your streaming services and your own files, with the controller.
faq.7.q: What if an update goes wrong?
faq.7.a: You can go back to how it was before.
faq.8.a: No. No account, no telemetry. Crash reports are sent only if you agree.
faq.9.q: How do I report a problem?
faq.9.a: Open an issue on GitHub: tell us your PC and what happened.
